limitations: Three static samples do not prove continuous collision clearance or detect all fully contained-solid overlap.

Counts include retained machinery contacts and later industrial-repair hardware; no all-pairs engineering pass inferred.
Form01 comparison is by exact pair identities on a different native, not a proof of identical intersection geometry.
